calls.reasoning: A flowchart of the command path is the clearest way to answer this. I'll sketch it as a diagram and then add a short explanation.
calls.text:
Here's how a command flows through ledger-cli:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[ledger add coffee 4.50] --> B[src/index.js parseArgs]
  B --> C{command?}
  C -->|add| D[commands/add.js]
  C -->|list| E[commands/list.js]
  C -->|total| F[commands/total.js]
  D --> G[parser.js parseLine]
  G --> H[(ledger.txt)]
```

Every command goes through the same front door: `src/index.js` parses the arguments, picks a command module, and that module reads or appends the plain-text ledger through `parser.js`. Nothing else touches the file, which keeps the format easy to reason about.
